title: Hello Cube
description: A lit, spinning cube — the smallest complete 3D scene.

title: Bouncing Sprites
description: Eight textured quads bouncing inside a 640x480 virtual frame.

title: Light Show
description: Four colored point lights orbiting a Phong sphere in real time.

title: CRT Bloom
description: A declarative post-effect chain: bloom plus a color filter.

title: Input Playground
description: An interactive tour of the F9 input API: mouse move/down/wheel callbacks paint a particle trail, keyboard events and held-state queries steer it, and surface-pixel pointer coordinates are mapped into the 2D frame. Self-plays until you interact.

title: Texture Showcase
description: A real CC0 paving-stone texture (ambientCG) loaded from the sample's asset pack: shown full and cropped with sourceRect, and tiled across a 3D ground plane and spinning cube.

title: glTF Model
description: A real CC0 glTF model (Avocado by Microsoft, Khronos glTF-Sample-Assets) imported with loadMeshData, base-color mapped and lit under the engine's Phong model.

title: Fox Walk
description: A real CC0 rigged model (Fox, Quaternius' Ultimate Animated Animals) imported with loadMeshData and CPU-posed with poseMesh from a script-owned clock, drawn with skinned: true.
